title: Sum over a filtered finite range
statement: Let $m$ be a natural number, let $p$ be a predicate on the integers from $0$ through $m-1$, and let $F$ assign an integer to each such integer. The sum of $F$ over the list of elements of this range satisfying $p$ equals the sum of $F(x)$ over the finite set of all such $x$.
hypotheses_covered: $p$ is a predicate on the finite range
$F$ maps the finite range to the integers
